mapper.insert: insert into item (member_id, item_name, item_info, donation_flag, price, category_id, price_negotiation_yn, post_date, view_count) values (#{memberId}, #{itemDto.itemName}, #{itemDto.itemInfo}, #{itemDto.donationFlag}, #{itemDto.price}, #{itemDto.categoryId}, #{itemDto.priceNegotiationYn}, #{itemDto.postDate}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT i.item_id, i.item_name, i.item_info, i.post_date, i.update_date, i.donation_flag, i.price, i.category_id, i.price_negotiation_yn, i.item_status_id, i.view_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite f WHERE f.item_id = i.item_id ) AS like_count, m.member_id, m.name, m.manners_temperature, r.si_do, r.si_gun_gu, r.eup_myeon_dong_gu, r.eup_myeon_li_dong, r.li FROM item AS i JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = i.member_id JOIN region AS r ON m.region_id = r.region_id WHERE i.item_id = #{itemId}

select m.member_id, m.name, m.manners_temperature, r.si_do, r.si_gun_gu, r.eup_myeon_dong_gu, r.eup_myeon_li_dong, r.li from member as m join region as r on m.region_id = r.region_id where m.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: update item set item_name = #{itemDto.itemName}, item_info = #{itemDto.itemInfo}, update_date = #{itemDto.updateDate}, donation_flag = #{itemDto.donationFlag}, category_id = #{itemDto.categoryId}, price_negotiation_yn = #{itemDto.priceNegotiationYn}, price = #{itemDto.price} where item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.insert: insert into buyer_review (item_id, member_id, review) values (#{itemId}, #{memberId}, #{reviewDto.review})
mapper.select: select item.item_name, brv.review, brv.member_id from buyer_review as brv join item on item.item_id = brv.item_id where item.item_id = #{itemId}
select rv.review, rv.member_id from buyer_review as rv join item on rv.item_id = item.item_id and item.member_id = #{memberId}
select item.item_name, srv.review from seller_review as srv join item on item.item_id = srv.item_id where item.item_id = #{itemId}

select srv.review, (select member_id from item where item.item_id = srv.item_id) as member_id from seller_review as srv join buyer_review as brv on srv.item_id = brv.item_id and brv.member_id = #{memberId}
